name: Jira
description: Tickets, sprints and epics from Jira, through Atlassian's acli. Feeds Tickets, the Sprint report, Today and the worktree cleaner.
author: cockpit

settings.label: Board name
settings.help: As Jira shows it, used to find the sprints

settings.label: Your name in Jira
settings.help: Only these tickets count as yours in the sprint report

settings.label: Ticket key pattern
settings.help: A regular expression, matched in branch names and titles

settings.label: Released statuses
settings.help: Count as shipped in the burnup

settings.label: Done for the sprint
settings.help: Done but maybe not released yet, like QA. Empty uses the released ones

settings.label: Project for new tickets
settings.help: Its key, like ACME. Empty uses the board's project

settings.label: Types of new tickets
settings.help: As Jira names them, one per line

settings.label: Required fields for new tickets
settings.help: Named sets of the custom fields your project requires, e.g. {"Web": {"customfield_10100": [{"value": "Web"}]}}. The first is the default

settings.label: Acceptance criteria field
settings.help: Its id, like customfield_10200, to ask for them when creating a ticket

settings.label: Sprint field
settings.help: Its id, to put a new ticket straight in the active sprint. Empty turns that off

settings.label: Epic link field
settings.help: Its id, to put a new ticket under an epic

install.darwin: brew tap atlassian/homebrew-acli && brew install acli
